claims.quote: Eephus Oatmeal Brown Ale is their signature brew and it stands above — it's exceptional
claims.note: Brown ale maps nearest to stout-porter/amber family; ground truth names Eephus explicitly.

claims.quote: Greenwood Vermont Style IPA … juicy nod to the hazy beers of the green mountain state; 'Greenwood NEIPA and WHIP IPA are a juicy haven'
taproom and bottle shop are family friendly; children and leashed dogs are always welcome; basset hound mascot named Wrigley
claims.note: Family/dog is IDENTITY here, not amenity — 'perfect spot… with friends or family'. Both locations.

claims.quote: 'Beer and baseball are synonymous. It's a slow sport, very conducive to drinking some beers with friends' … staff 'legends'; 'My absolute favorite brewery in Toronto'

lines: “Beer and baseball are synonymous. It’s a slow sport, very conducive to drinking some beers with friends and catching up with one another. That’s the vibe we wanted in the space.”

claims.quote: 'The sour beers at Left Field are phenomenal'; Go-Ahead raspberry-hibiscus gose ('actual raspberries, not chemical fake'); sunflower seed gose 'puckeringly sour and refreshingly complex'
claims.source: BeerAdvocate voice + Adventures with Peps review

claims.quote: 'one of the best and most consistent breweries in Toronto… excels at a wide range of styles, from continental lagers to hoppy pale ales to kettle sours to porters and stouts'
claims.note: Lagers named inside a breadth claim, not a dedicated lager review — weakest of the round. Single class, B ceiling, and strength should sit low.

claims.quote: Blackburne Imperial Stout series — Bourbon Barrel Aged Blackburne, 10.7%, one year in Traverse City Whiskey Co. barrels: 'swirling oaky aromas of sweet cocoa giving way to bold, sticky dark chocolate, vanilla and caramel'; annual editions covered by Canadian Beer News; a fan site documents the series
claims.source: Canadian Beer News + baseballismy.life + BeerAdvocate listing
